changelog: New admin menu system added for future implementation.
Fixed an issue where canceling the progressbar could keep it busy in some cases.
Test command code removed from the gizmo file.
NPC dialog improved with HTML text support.
NPC dialog item selection UX improved.
Item option buttons in npcDialog now appear gray when the user has not selected any item.
Option added to display required items in npcDialog.
Fixed GetUserSkin for qb and qbox.
Client-side item caching improved, items are now cached only when requested by the user.
Improved item caching support for ak47_inventory, codem-inventory, core_inventory, qs-inventory, and tgiann-inventory.
slotData support added to all inventory integrations, allowing items to be used together with their metadata.
Fixed metadata item usage support, including devhub_licenses as an item.
Fixed GetItemData in core_inventory.
Fixed GetAllItems in codem-inventory.
Added ability to connect images in place of skill icons.
Added tooltips added to the Skill Tree generator to clarify the purpose of each parameter.
Added new option to hide category visibility for specific users: Config.CategoryVisibilityHandler.
Added functionality to remove XP within the current level range without reducing the level.
Added server-side exports: removePoints and removeXp.
Added uI configuration to adjust sound volume and customize number formatting.
Added text formatting for XP numbers in the UI.
Added missing translations in the Skill Tree generator.
Added client-side export: closeSkillTree.
Added server-side export: getUnlockedSkills.
Added client-side export: getConfig.
Added new options in the generator for skill tree customization.
Added system to block unlocking of certain skills if another skill is unlocked.
Added additional animations in the UI, such as confetti upon unlocking a skill.
Added highlight color changed to the primary theme color.
Added summary of missed errors added during the save attempt in the generator.
Fixed cached keybind issue for opening the menu via keybind.
Fixed skill category selection centering in the top panel.
Fixed incorrectly displayed warning about duplicate UID in the generator when replacing a previously assigned UID.
Fixed issue where opening a new skill info window replaced information in an already open window.
Resolved an issue that was causing the Herbal Skill Tree to fail loading occasionally
Fixed sound not working in certain cases.
Improved rendering performance of various Skill Tree UI components.
Improved validation of already-used categories in the generator.
Improved validation of used UIDs, points, and skill effects.
Improved highlighting of skills with errors or missing required data in the generator.
Renamed parameters in exports and listeners for better intuitiveness.
Expanded README and documentation with numerous examples for using exports and listeners.
Updated resource name, exports, and listeners to align with new scripts for consistency.
[Old export and listener names will continue to work, so no changes are required in existing code. Script name changes in the CFG are also unnecessary.]

[All files should be replaced except configs/sh.skills.lua and configs/sh.main.lua. The remaining config files can be easily compared, and only the additions should be transferred. The updates are marked as 'update 2.0.0'.]
Skill degradation states are now stored separately for each category and skill using category::uid, preventing conflicts between identically named skills in different categories.
Existing player degradation data is migrated automatically on first load, while orphaned entries belonging to removed skills are cleaned up.
Fully depleted skills now lose their effects immediately instead of keeping effects such as speed, health, or recoil modifiers active until the next login.
Skill effects are automatically restored when a degraded skill recovers.
Pre-made skill effects can no longer stack when the skill unlock event is triggered again, including after degradation recovery.
Reaching the maximum level in one category no longer prevents XP from being awarded to other categories during the same tick.
Buffered XP from Config.XpCacheLimit is now saved for the correct character during character switching instead of leaking to the next character.
Legacy dh_skillTree:client:listener:skillUnlocked events are replayed when the player loads, restoring perks used by legacy integrations.
Player death status is now tracked correctly, fixing Config.CloseUiOnDeath and the server-side death validation.
Last Stand weapon damage modifiers are now restored correctly for each weapon, and stale modifier entries are removed after switching weapons.
Damage Reduction now calculates reductions using the current health value instead of stale health data.
Keyboard navigation in the Skill Tree UI no longer crashes at grid boundaries or moves incorrectly between wrapped rows.
The getSkillEffect export now returns 0 for unknown categories or skills instead of returning a placeholder value on the client or throwing an error on the server.
Config.DisabledListeners entries are normalized when the resource loads and safely accept false, true, or partial client and server settings.
Configuration comments now document all supported listener formats and warn that disabling listeners may break dependent resources.
Server-side XP validation now rejects non-numeric, NaN, infinite, zero, and negative values.
Awarded XP values are now rounded down to whole numbers.
The Skill Tree generator now escapes special characters in category titles, groups, and icons, preventing characters such as apostrophes from corrupting generated skill configuration.
Save operations now have lower overhead when Config.Debug is disabled because unnecessary debug JSON encoding is skipped.
Fixed a bug where a player was not reverted to their original clothes after being removed from a group during work.
Integrated the script with the new sound system from devhub_lib.
Added Shared.SoundVolume to the config and volume to config.js.
Added a notification when a player is accepted into a group.
Renamed dh_miner to devhub_miner, no further action required.
Requires devhub_lib update to version 2.0.0.
Optimized events sent to the client, improving event handling and reducing unnecessary client-side data transfers.
Added Config.HerbBlipCategory in configs/client.lua to set the map legend category id and name for herb blips. Set it to false to list them separately.
Fixed herbalism skill tree boosts not being applied when the legacy dh_skillTree events were disabled in devhub_skillTree.
Improved the map legend by grouping all herb blips into one "Herbs" category instead of listing each herb separately.
Fixed an issue where skill spells were displaying a locked icon when both management systems were disabled.
Improved the group system for better stability and coordination.
Improved tree synchronization between players.
Fixed target compatibility issues with older versions of ox_target.
Handler support added for each multi-recipe, allowing custom logic execution per recipe.
Adjusted minigame 4 difficulty, which became unintentionally too hard to complete after the last update.
Fixed an issue with the job ranking system not displaying or sorting correctly on some setups.
Removed the get_jobs_leaderboard SQL procedure due to compatibility issues with certain MariaDB versions
Error 'ERR_REQUEST_RANGE_NOT_SATISFIABLE' caused by the default .ogg music file has been fixed.
Default .ogg music file replaced with a .mp3 version (different song).
User sound volume is now saved in local storage, so users only need to set it once.
Fixed an issue where one of the minigames would start automatically, causing the screen to briefly fade.
Initial release
Fixed the player who started the job sometimes seeing an empty crime scene while helpers saw everything. Failed object spawns are now retried.
Fixed blood floating in the air after the body under it was removed, which made it impossible to clean. Blood is now placed on the real ground.
Fixed the UV flashlight not revealing blood near an object that was already picked up or loaded into the van.
Fixed the UV flashlight pausing after revealing one blood splat.
Fixed scene objects sometimes spawning in the air or on top of the van or another object.
Fixed carried objects being put down on top of the van or another object instead of the ground.
Fixed two objects sometimes spawning in the same spot, and a possible server freeze when a location had too few spawn points.
Fixed the "Burn object" option on looted objects doing nothing.
Fixed players getting stuck turning toward an object another player had just picked up.
Fixed players staying stuck carrying an object when the job ended, and objects held by a player who logged out becoming impossible to pick up.
Fixed the van storage options still being available after the scene was cleaned.
Fixed the van storage editor opening twice, and the player and van staying frozen if it failed to open.
Fixed loading objects into the van not working after a restart during a job.
Fixed job vans, carried props and van storage zones being left behind after a resource restart.
Fixed the delayed van cleanup sometimes deleting a different vehicle.
Fixed vehicle disposal failing or using the wrong spot when more than one disposal type was enabled in Config.VehicleDisposal.
Fixed vehicle disposal (burn, drown, push off cliff) not working when another player drove the van last.
Fixed the police alert and vehicle disposal triggering twice when a scene was finished.
Fixed rewards and the final police alert being given when the job owner logged out before finishing.
Fixed duplicate objects appearing after a player reloaded their character.
Fixed the job owner receiving too few items when two object types use the same required item.
Fixed several job server events that could be triggered without doing the matching in-game step.
Changed carried objects so they can no longer be put down from inside a vehicle.
Added Config.DisableWhileDead, allowing the Guidebook to automatically close and preventing it from being opened while the player is dead.

Added support for HTML formatting inside Guidebook text, allowing the use of tags such as
and other HTML formatting elements.
Fixed navigation menu failing to render after map use.
Restored source files in source version that were accidentally escrowed in the last update.
Resolved an issue in Minigame 7 that allowed players to complete the minigame earlier than intended.
Required actions added for crime trader missions.
Improved the way external apps are added to minimize issues with them appearing as not owned.
Added Shared.AbortPickupOnDeath, enabled by default, to cancel the open-crate minigame when the player dies or enters a downed state.
Added the ShouldAbortAirDropPickup(data) hook for custom pickup cancellation conditions, including framework-specific downed states or leaving the crate area.
The open-crate minigame is now cancelled when the crate despawns.
The server no longer grants loot to dead players.
Updated devhub_lib so Core.CloseProgressbar() properly aborts an active Core.ShowProgressbar() and triggers its callback with false.
Fixed an issue where players could sometimes fall under the map after entering a house.
Removed server console warnings.
New npcdialog system added for immersive interaction with the mission NPC.
New optional requirements system added for starting missions.
Mission requirements are now displayed inside the laptop UI.
Mission requirements are now displayed inside the NPC dialog interface.
Incorrect text in the Races tab has been fixed.
Fixed an issue where the 3D race-join marker was displayed incorrectly when only one race was active.
Added an admin option in the race details menu to cancel a planned race.
Added a 20-second grace period after leaving a race vehicle. Players who do not return before the timer expires are removed from the race.
Improved the appearance of 3D race checkpoints.
Fixed force-started races triggered through the startRace command not finishing correctly.
Added the open client function ShouldShowJoinUi, allowing server owners to control when the 3D race-join UI is displayed.
Added the exports exports['devhub_racing']:JoinNearestRace() and exports['devhub_racing']:JoinRaceById(raceId), allowing server owners to create custom race-joining methods.
Improved race progress calculations for more accurate progress values.
Fixed race progress reaching 100% before the race was completed.
Fixed the 3D race UI being displayed while the map was open.
Added the open function ShouldShowBlip, allowing server owners to control race blip visibility.
Slight radio performance optimization for smoother usage.
Config.HideMemberList added, allowing the radio member list to be hidden (requested by a customer).
Config files are now unescrowed.
Added a comprehensive crafting debug mode displaying all crafting locations, camera positions, and detailed crafting information.
Added ID validation in the admin panel to prevent duplicate crafting IDs.
Added the updateLicenseData(source, owner, licenseId, fields, reason) export for updating data fields on an already issued license.
License cards can now be reprinted using the player's current data instead of the snapshot stored when the license was originally issued.
The updateLicenseData export now supports licenses belonging to offline players.
License data updates are restricted to fields declared in Config.DataFields, with additional support for updating the license photo.
The card holder is automatically refreshed for every player currently carrying the updated license.
Added the OnLicenseDataUpdated open function hook.
Added a new Data Updated entry to the license profile history timeline.
Added missing translations for the new history entry and related error message.
Fixed the card holder breaking when the server pushed a license update while the UI was open.
Fixed status changes and newly issued licenses failing to redraw correctly after a server-side license update.
License updates are no longer pushed to the card holder while inspecting another player's licenses, preventing active inspections from being interrupted.
Added internal test coverage for the new license data update export.
Actions now work correctly even when the server has action keys disabled.
Added detailed step-by-step console logs for the whole heist, shown when Shared.Debug.Enabled is turned on in configs/shared.lua.
Fixed the antenna hacking monitor not spawning on older game builds, which blocked the heist. Its model now ships in the new stream folder.
Fixed the train's cargo wagons disappearing on the way to the interception point, which put the loot on the locomotive instead of the open wagons.
Fixed ox_target warnings in the F8 console about removing zones that do not exist.
Fixed developer test commands being available to every player. They now only exist with Shared.Debug.Enabled on and are limited to admins.
Fixed server errors caused by invalid data in the heist end event and the AddToQueue, RemoveFromQueue and GetQueuePosition exports.
Changed debug settings to a single switch, Shared.Debug.Enabled in configs/shared.lua. Config.Debug was removed from configs/client.lua and configs/server.lua.
Changed the console to stay quiet with debug off, except for errors, which always print and are limited so they cannot flood the console.
Added open functions on both the client and server side, allowing for greater script customization and easier integration with external resources.
Added a check that makes sure all exercise props and animations are loaded and spawned before a set starts.
Added Config.ExerciseLoading in configs/client.lua to set the loading timeout (timeoutMs) and to pre-download exercise animations when gym equipment is nearby (prewarm).
Added a loading hint while an exercise loads. The start is canceled with a notification if loading times out or the player walks away.
Added skill degradation settings to every gym skill in configs/skillTree.lua, used when skill degradation is enabled in devhub_skillTree.
Fixed the gym for players with a slow internet connection, who could get stuck in the equipment while props or animations were still loading.
Fixed players staying locked in place when an exercise animation failed to load.
Fixed leaving an exercise stalling on slow connections, which also left the dumbbells in hand on the shoulder press and seated lateral raise.
Fixed the idle cinematic camera kicking in during long sets and while spotting another player.
Fixed the gym menu sometimes ignoring clicks after a minigame ended.
Fixed the IsBusinessPanelOpen and GetCurrentBusinessId client exports always reporting that no panel was open.
Fixed one malformed gym entry in the database stopping the remaining equipment and interaction points from spawning.
Fixed gym profiles staying loaded after players disconnected, which made memory use and autosaves grow over time.
Fixed player load and unload events accepting requests made on behalf of another player.
Fixed Execution of function reference in script host failed errors after restarting devhub_gym2.
Improved client performance by removing a 12 to 22 ms frame spike every 3 seconds caused by gym prop spawning, and by skipping gyms far from the player.
Improved client performance of the background loops for removed map props, ped clearing and exercise controls.
Improved server performance by caching online player identifiers for business updates, employee calls, helper prompts and wage payouts.
Improved server performance by looking up character names once per session instead of on every exercise start and gym menu open.
Improved server performance when saving gym settings in the creator with many players online.
Improved the fatigue recovery and autosave loops to spread their work over several frames.
Changed error messages to always print in the console, even with debug disabled. Repeats are limited to once every 30 seconds.
